svg.text: > i break a test to check it works
A passing suite can rest on a false guarantee: an assertion that never executes, or a runner
that quietly collects fewer files than exist and prints a pass anyway.
> rules nobody enforces stop being followed
In FlowOps they are build failures instead, and each gate carries a comment naming the
defect that got past everything already watching.
A service-layer check is correct until a second caller appears, a migration runs, or someone
opens a database client. A partial unique index is correct regardless.
Most explain what, which the code already says. The variable people forget is the one whose
failure looks like an unrelated problem.
